project_info.theme: Techcombank Priority Visa Asia travel no foreign fee benefit

main_subject.detail: A premium travel-benefit poster with the Visa logo top left and Techcombank logo top right. Headline reads 'Vi vu A Chau - Khong lo ve phi'. A long rounded banner states '0% Phi ngoai te | Hoan 4% Giao dich quoc te'. Centered is a large Techcombank Priority card in black with a gold geometric emblem. To the right stands a smiling couple in elegant neutral outfits carrying shopping bags in front of the Merlion statue. A floating rounded badge at lower left says '0% Phi ngoai te'. Bottom-right lifestyle plate reads 'Dinh hinh PHONG CACH SONG'. A small footnote says '* Ap dung dieu kien dieu khoan theo muc chi tieu'.
main_subject.style: Luxury travel-and-shopping banking poster with glossy premium card hero and aspirational couple lifestyle imagery
